set.description: Open an authorized Linux session on a selected KVM or Firecracker service. The VPSnet guest channel works without a VM IP, SSH password or guest internet connection; choose connectionMethod="guest" for network/SSH troubleshooting or "ssh" for the independent SSH path. Auto prefers the guest channel. Requires explicit VM permission. Omit sessionBinding for a new session; VPSnet generates it and returns it with sessionId. Reuse both returned values for commands, files and reconnects. The OS user is root. Read /etc/os-release through the first operation to verify guest connectivity before choosing OS-specific commands or making changes. An empty managed-app list does not mean the server has no software.

connectionMethod.description: auto prefers the internal guest agent; guest needs no VM network or SSH; ssh explicitly opens the independent delegated SSH channel. Never change transport to replay a command whose outcome is unknown.

sessionBinding.description: Omit for a new session. To reconnect, copy the exact 32-character lowercase hexadecimal sessionBinding returned by open_vm_session; do not supply a UUID with hyphens or a descriptive name.

set.description: Reinstall OS on a VPS or qualified dedicated server. WARNING: destroys existing data; confirm with the user before reinstalling. Cloud VPS and Firecracker VPS: reinstall also deletes existing snapshots, so they cannot provide rollback after reinstall. Read get_os_options.snapshotDeletion first; when snapshots exist, set confirmSnapshotDelete to true only after the user explicitly confirms their deletion. A pending snapshot action blocks reinstall until it finishes. Container VPS has no snapshots. Dedicated servers erase every disk and have no snapshot rollback; get_os_options reports dedicated=true and confirmRequired=true. Pass confirmReinstall=true only after the user explicitly approves reinstalling that exact dedicated server and losing all disk data. Use an account public sshKey ID from list_ssh_keys. If omitted, a dedicated server reuses its installed key when available; otherwise VPSnet generates a password and delivers it through the customer's existing VPSnet access flow, not this tool. Do not ask for or pass passwords through this connector; use the VPSnet panel to set a chosen password. Dedicated reinstall returns a reinstall job ID. VPS reinstall returns a noty UUID for acceptance; follow get_service_history for completion. Acceptance is not completion. OAuth requires services:reinstall; API keys require full access.

confirmReinstall.description: Dedicated only: true only after explicit user approval to reinstall this exact server and erase all its disks; never inferred or defaulted.

confirmSnapshotDelete.description: Cloud VPS and Firecracker VPS only: set true only after the user explicitly confirms deletion of the existing snapshots shown by get_os_options.snapshotDeletion. They cannot provide rollback after reinstall. Never inferred or enabled automatically.

orderNo.description: Tenant-owned service order number: 1-64 ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, e.g. VP12345 or VP12345-1

sshKey.description: Account public SSH key ID from list_ssh_keys. If omitted, dedicated servers reuse an installed key when available; otherwise VPSnet generates and delivers a password through its existing customer access flow. Never send a private key or password.
